The 12-page datasheet identifies Custom 630 as 17-4 precipitation-hardening stainless steel, UNS S17400, and lists ASTM A564 among the applicable specifications. It lists bar rounds among manufactured forms. Its H1150 values, including 7,820 kg/m3 density, 869 MPa 0.2% yield strength and 993 MPa ultimate strength, are explicitly **typical** and are not project allowables or certificate minima.

The R106 candidate requires certified ASTM A564/A564M Type 630 bar supplied in condition H1150. The received material certificate, heat/lot identity, heat-treatment condition and positive material identification remain required. Condition A material is prohibited in the finished candidate. Qualified review must establish design allowables and proof acceptance before any fabrication release.
